entries.subject: ESA/Webb weic2603a
entries.finding: COSMOS Field MoM-z14 Galaxy (NIRCam pullout image): Webb NIRCam, ten filters from 0.9 to 4.4 µm. The lab reads a 488 x 488 px window of the Publication JPEG, 0.58 arcsec across. The file carries no sky tags; the scale (0.0011915 arcsec per pixel, to about 5%; 0.000194 arcsec per pixel of the 24,567 px Large JPEG) and the direction of north (90.14° left of vertical) are the project's measurements, recorded in src/sources/esawebb-weic2603a.json.

entries.subject: Webb NIRCam science mosaics from MAST
entries.finding: Not used. The lab recipe reads a display image by URL; the archive's mosaics would need a cutout, a display transfer of our own and a hosted file, and the telescope tooling has no cutout command for survey mosaics. The galaxy is a few pixels either way.
entries.revisitWhen: The lab recipe can read a prepared local image, or the telescope tooling cuts mosaics by position.

entries.subject: Spheroid
entries.finding: Naidu et al. (2025), Section 3.2 and Table 1: Sérsic index 1.0 +/- 0.2, semi-major axis 147 pc, axis ratio 0.25, extended north to south. Used as published; the position angle is the paper's words, not a number. The same section reports about 90 pc from pysersic on the mosaics.

entries.subject: Flat picture bank
entries.finding: The first version drew the publisher's picture as one flat image facing the Sun (mom-z14-layers); seen from the side it was a line. Replaced by this volume.
